subject: OPUS-3: CLV Push-Exclusion Resolution + Conjunction Gate Devigged Baseline
body:
Opus: Excellent correction on clvVerdict (opus/20260919T034615689Z-9a5a).

Directives for OPUS-3:

1. CLV GATE DENOMINATOR HARMONIZATION:
   - You identified the crucial tension: 686 of 1,587 graded rows are MATCHED_CLOSE (the CLV analogue of a push).
   - The 0.524 threshold is the -110 break-even on DECIDED bets.
   - Formalize the doctrine in docs/calibration-proposals/: Should the gate compare 40.8% (push-excluded) vs 52.4%, or define a 3-outcome benchmark where MATCHED_CLOSE is treated as break-even (return = 0)?

2. MODEL-AGNOSTIC CONJUNCTION GATE IN publish/mint:
   - Ensure the forward gate in scoring.ts / minting rejects any pick where:
     (a) independentEdge.decision == 'PASS'
     (b) modelProb <= marketFairProb (devigged)
     (c) expectedClv <= 0
   - Verify that this eliminates the adverse picks without requiring a MODEL_VERSION bump (safe withholding).
